# RM brief — AEVUS LIMITED (09064817)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by SEC-07 — Negative pledge  
**Before an offer:** management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before a facility is offered. The condition stands whatever the overall outcome. (CON-04)  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- AEVUS LIMITED (company number 09064817) is an active private limited company incorporated on 2014-06-02, roughly 148 months ago, trading under SIC code 87300. `[profile; computed]`
- The board is stable: two officers are in post, only two have ever served, and there have been no appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- The only charge on the register, 090648170001, was created on 2014-08-12 in favour of HSBC Bank PLC and is recorded as fully satisfied; it contained fixed and floating charges plus a negative pledge. Satisfied charges are disregarded for ranking, so the company's security position is otherwise clean and a first charge could rank first. `[090648170001; SEC-02; SEC-03]`
- Because that charge carries a negative pledge, the case is referred under SEC-07: no further charge may be created over the same security without the existing lender's written consent, and that consent must be evidenced before any facility is offered. `[SEC-07; 090648170001]`
- Filing conduct is consistently good — every one of the eleven accounts filings on record was submitted ahead of its deadline, the most recent (made up to 2025-06-30) landing 129 days early on 2025-11-19. `[AA filed 2025-11-19; AA filed 2025-03-06; AA filed 2023-08-08; AA filed 2022-11-04; AA filed 2021-11-15; AA filed 2021-02-02; AA filed 2019-09-16; AA filed 2018-11-20; AA filed 2018-02-06; AA filed 2016-11-21; AA filed 2016-03-01]`
- Accounts are not overdue, with the next set due 2027-03-31, although the latest figures are now 15 months old as at the 2026-09-30 review date. `[profile; computed]`
- The accounts are filed on the total exemption full basis, which does not disclose turnover or profit, so under CON-04 simply obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months before an offer is made — this is missing information rather than an adverse indicator. `[CON-04; profile; AA filed 2025-11-19]`
